Tasks/Furniture Assembly

Furniture Assembly

Lay a panel flat, slide a rail into its groove, and fasten it by turning a wing screw by hand.

Stage definitions

Exact slices of the parent sequence.

Canonical instructions, handedness, action width, horizon, and success conditions are drawn from the current task registry and success-contract documentation.

#Stage / environmentHandActionMax stepsSuccess summary
01Lay panel flatSharpaAngledMobilePanelLayFlatLeft-v1Left29600Place the panel groove-up, inside the target footprint, released and stable for five steps.
02Insert railSharpaAngledMobileRailInsert-v1Right29700Seat the rail within 2 mm depth, 4 mm lateral and 8 mm wall tolerances; hold for five steps.
03Fasten wing screwSharpaAngledMobileScrewFasten-v1Right29900Turn the wing screw clockwise to at least 87.1°; no screwdriver is used.
